title: 😤 Ishaan loses his work logins daily... the browser profile he skipped #browser #profiles
title_alts: 🧩 Ishaan needs two browser profiles... each window keeps its own logins #browser #profiles
🔐 Ishaan mixes work and personal tabs... the wrong account posts first #browser #profiles
description_hook: Two accounts in one browser means one of them is always signed out. A second profile keeps each set of logins in its own window.

characters.name: Ishaan
characters.description: thirty, short black hair, grey hoodie, silver watch on left wrist

scenes.narration: Ishaan opens his work email. He is signed out again.
scenes.caption: ईशान वर्क ईमेल खोलता है। वह फिर से साइन आउट हो गया।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop on a wooden desk showing a mail sign-in page where an inbox used to be, a cold cup of tea beside it, morning light from a window on the left.

scenes.narration: Your browser holds both mail accounts. They overwrite each other.
scenes.caption: उसके ब्राउज़र में दोनों मेल अकाउंट हैं। वे एक-दूसरे को हटा देते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: One browser window with two mail tabs open, both tabs showing the same account picture in the corner, the screen the only light in a dim room.

scenes.narration: Cookies live per profile, not per tab. Same profile means one session wins.
scenes.caption: कुकीज़ प्रोफ़ाइल से जुड़ी हैं, टैब से नहीं। एक प्रोफ़ाइल में एक ही सेशन टिकता है।
scenes.image_brief: A monitor split between a logged-in inbox on one half and an empty sign-in form on the other, a small padlock icon in the address bar, even indoor light.

scenes.narration: Nothing to install. You need your work password handy.
scenes.caption: कुछ इंस्टॉल नहीं करना है। बस वर्क पासवर्ड पास रखें।
scenes.image_brief: A tidy desk with a closed notebook, a pen and a folded sticky note, no cables or clutter, soft daylight across the surface.

scenes.narration: Also decide which account should own the default window.
scenes.caption: यह भी तय करें कि डिफ़ॉल्ट विंडो किस अकाउंट की रहेगी।
scenes.image_brief: Two browser windows overlapping on a monitor, one with a blue account badge and one with an orange badge, warm lamp light behind the screen.

scenes.narration: Click your picture in the top corner of the browser window.
scenes.caption: ब्राउज़र विंडो के ऊपरी कोने में अपनी तस्वीर पर क्लिक करें।
scenes.image_brief: The top right corner of a browser window filling the screen, the round account picture button ringed and glowing, the rest of the page pale behind it.

scenes.narration: Choose add profile, name it Work, and sign in to that account there.
scenes.caption: नई प्रोफ़ाइल जोड़ें चुनें, नाम वर्क रखें और उसी में साइन इन करें।
scenes.image_brief: A browser profile menu open on screen with an add profile option and a small text field holding the typed word Work, dark room lit only by the display.

scenes.narration: Pin that profile to your taskbar so it opens separately.
scenes.caption: उस प्रोफ़ाइल को टास्कबार पर पिन करें, ताकि वह अलग खुले।
scenes.image_brief: The bottom taskbar of a desktop with two separate browser icons pinned side by side, each carrying a different small coloured badge, cool blue desktop glow.

scenes.narration: Open both windows side by side. Check the small picture in each top corner.
scenes.caption: दोनों विंडो साथ में खोलें। हर विंडो के कोने की छोटी तस्वीर देखें।
scenes.image_brief: Two browser windows snapped side by side on one monitor, a different account picture visible in each top corner, daylight from a window behind the desk.

scenes.narration: Your personal mail should stay logged in. Nothing should bounce.
scenes.caption: आपका निजी मेल लॉगिन ही रहना चाहिए। कुछ भी नहीं टूटेगा।
scenes.image_brief: A personal inbox open and fully loaded on a laptop, a list of unread messages down the left side, evening lamp light falling on the keyboard.

scenes.narration: Profiles are not privacy. A shared computer still needs separate user accounts, each with a password.
scenes.caption: प्रोफ़ाइल प्राइवेसी नहीं है। शेयर कंप्यूटर पर पासवर्ड वाले अलग यूज़र अकाउंट चाहिए।
scenes.image_brief: A shared family desktop computer in a living room showing an operating system sign-in screen with two user tiles and a password box, lamp light from the corner.

scenes.narration: And do not use a work profile for personal banking.
scenes.caption: और वर्क प्रोफ़ाइल में निजी बैंकिंग कभी न करें।
scenes.image_brief: A bank sign-in page open in a browser on a laptop with a work lanyard and badge lying on the desk beside it, dim evening light.

scenes.narration: Make one profile tonight. Name it Work. Sign in once and stop guessing.
scenes.caption: आज एक प्रोफ़ाइल बनाएं। नाम वर्क रखें। एक बार साइन इन करें।
scenes.image_brief: A freshly created browser profile window on a laptop, the profile name Work visible and the sign-in field still empty, a single warm lamp on a night desk.

title: 🐌 Rhea's browser eats all her memory... the task manager inside it #browser #extensions
title_alts: 🔎 Rhea opens the browser task manager... it names the tab eating memory #browser #extensions
😵 Rhea blames her old laptop for lag... one extension was the cost #browser #extensions
description_hook: The laptop is not too old. One extension is holding the memory, and the browser has its own task manager that will name it.

characters.name: Rhea
characters.description: twenty-two, long wavy hair tied back, green kurta, round glasses

scenes.narration: Rhea's fan roars and every tab stutters. Nothing is downloading.
scenes.caption: रिया का पंखा तेज़ चल रहा है और हर टैब अटक रहा है। कुछ डाउनलोड नहीं हो रहा।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop on a cluttered study desk with a browser window of half loaded tabs, the side vent grille visible and a scarf pushed aside, warm afternoon light.

scenes.narration: Each extension runs as its own process. Idle ones still hold memory.
scenes.caption: हर एक्सटेंशन अलग प्रोसेस में चलता है। खाली बैठे भी वे मेमोरी लेते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A browser toolbar filling the screen with a long row of small extension icons beside the address bar, the page below blank white, dim room.

scenes.narration: Your browser hides that from the system task list. So the laptop takes the blame.
scenes.caption: ब्राउज़र यह सिस्टम की टास्क लिस्ट से छिपा देता है। इसलिए दोष लैपटॉप पर आता है।
scenes.image_brief: An operating system task list open on a monitor with one single browser row highlighted and everything else quiet, cool white desk light.

scenes.narration: You need nothing installed. Just the browser window in front.
scenes.caption: कुछ इंस्टॉल करने की ज़रूरत नहीं। सिर्फ़ ब्राउज़र विंडो सामने रखें।
scenes.image_brief: An almost empty desk holding only an open laptop with one blank browser window, a glass of water at the edge, soft morning light.

scenes.narration: Know which extensions you actually use weekly. Write them down.
scenes.caption: जानें कि आप कौन से एक्सटेंशन हर हफ़्ते इस्तेमाल करते हैं। उन्हें लिख लें।
scenes.image_brief: A paper notebook beside a keyboard with a short handwritten list of names down the page and a pen resting on it, lamp light from the right.

scenes.narration: Press Shift and Escape together to open the browser's own task manager.
scenes.caption: शिफ़्ट और एस्केप साथ दबाएं, ब्राउज़र का अपना टास्क मैनेजर खुलेगा।
scenes.image_brief: A small browser task manager panel floating over a web page, listing rows of tabs and extensions with memory and process columns, screen glow in a dark room.

scenes.narration: Click the memory column heading so the heaviest rows rise.
scenes.caption: मेमोरी कॉलम के शीर्षक पर क्लिक करें, भारी पंक्तियां ऊपर आ जाएंगी।
scenes.image_brief: The same browser task manager panel with the memory column heading underlined and a small sort arrow beside it, the heaviest rows now at the top, dim room.

scenes.narration: Select the worst offender, then press end process.
scenes.caption: सबसे भारी पंक्ति चुनें, फिर एंड प्रोसेस दबाएं।
scenes.image_brief: A browser task manager panel with one extension row selected in solid blue and an end process button at the lower right, bright screen in a shaded room.

scenes.narration: Did the fan quiet down? Scroll a heavy page and feel it.
scenes.caption: पंखा शांत हुआ? कोई भारी पेज स्क्रॉल करके देखें।
scenes.image_brief: A quiet laptop on a desk with a long article page mid scroll and crisp text, a still curtain beside the window, filtered daylight on the keyboard.

scenes.narration: Reopen the manager. That row should be gone.
scenes.caption: मैनेजर फिर खोलें। वह पंक्ति गायब होनी चाहिए।
scenes.image_brief: A browser task manager panel reopened and now showing a short list with an obvious gap where the heavy row used to sit, evening lamp light.

scenes.narration: Never end a row you cannot name. Some are the page itself.
scenes.caption: जिसका नाम न पहचानें उसे बंद न करें। कुछ पंक्तियां खुद पेज की होती हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A browser task manager panel where several rows carry ordinary page titles and one row is marked as the current tab, the display the only light source.

scenes.narration: Open that manager now. Sort by memory. Read the top name.
scenes.caption: अभी वह मैनेजर खोलें। मेमोरी से सॉर्ट करें। सबसे ऊपर का नाम पढ़ें।
scenes.image_brief: A browser task manager panel freshly sorted by memory with the top row's title clearly legible and the cursor resting on it, morning light on the desk.

title: 😵 Chirag's tabs shrink to slivers... the tab group habit he skips #browser #tabgroups
title_alts: 📁 Chirag groups tabs by task... each group collapses into one label #browser #tabgroups
🤯 Chirag closes the wrong window at midnight... the tabs he cannot name #browser #tabgroups
description_hook: Once the tab strip turns into coloured slivers, nothing is findable. Tab groups fold a whole task behind one label you can name.

characters.name: Chirag
characters.description: twenty-eight, buzz cut, black t-shirt, thin beaded bracelet

scenes.narration: Chirag's tabs are slivers now. No titles, only tiny icons.
scenes.caption: चिराग के टैब सिर्फ़ लकीरें बन गए हैं। नाम नहीं, बस छोटे आइकन।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop screen with a browser tab strip crammed with dozens of narrow tabs reduced to slivers of colour, no titles readable, cool evening light in the room.

scenes.narration: Every tab you keep open shrinks the ones beside it.
scenes.caption: हर खुला टैब अपने पड़ोसी टैब को और पतला कर देता है।
scenes.image_brief: A browser tab strip filling the screen where one new tab has just opened and every neighbouring tab has squeezed thinner, screen light on a dark desk.

scenes.narration: Your memory of what a tab held fades faster than the tab does. Then you keep it, just in case.
scenes.caption: टैब में क्या था, यह याद टैब से पहले मिट जाती है। फिर भी हम उसे रखे रहते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop showing a browser tab strip of blank identical favicons with the page below scrolled to nowhere, a cold mug beside the trackpad, late night lamp light.

scenes.narration: Decide the tasks you have running. Booking, invoices, reading, whatever they are.
scenes.caption: तय करें कि कौन-कौन से काम चल रहे हैं। बुकिंग, बिल, पढ़ाई, जो भी हो।
scenes.image_brief: A desk with a small paper list of four task names written in marker propped against a monitor stand showing a busy browser, warm morning light.

scenes.narration: Right click a tab and choose add to new group.
scenes.caption: किसी टैब पर राइट क्लिक करें और नए ग्रुप में जोड़ें चुनें।
scenes.image_brief: A browser tab with a right click menu open over it, an add to new group option visible in the list, dim room lit by the screen.

scenes.narration: Name the group for the task and pick a colour.
scenes.caption: ग्रुप का नाम उस काम पर रखें और एक रंग चुनें।
scenes.image_brief: A small group naming bubble open above a browser tab strip with a task name typed inside and a row of colour dots below it, bright screen.

scenes.narration: Drag the related tabs onto that group until they sit together.
scenes.caption: उससे जुड़े टैब खींचकर उस ग्रुप में साथ ले आएं।
scenes.image_brief: A browser tab strip mid drag, one tab lifted slightly and pulled towards a coloured group bracket that already holds two tabs, screen glow only.

scenes.narration: Click the group name. It folds into a single coloured chip.
scenes.caption: ग्रुप के नाम पर क्लिक करें। वह एक रंगीन चिप में सिमट जाएगा।
scenes.image_brief: A browser tab strip where a whole group has collapsed into one coloured chip with a short label, leaving wide readable tabs beside it, daylight from the side.

scenes.narration: Your tab titles should be readable again. Are they?
scenes.caption: आपके टैब के नाम फिर पढ़े जाने चाहिए। पढ़े जा रहे हैं?
scenes.image_brief: A browser tab strip with a handful of wide tabs whose titles are fully readable, each with a clear favicon, soft afternoon light across the keyboard.

scenes.narration: Groups are not bookmarks. Anything you need next month belongs in bookmarks.
scenes.caption: ग्रुप बुकमार्क नहीं हैं। अगले महीने चाहिए चीज़ें बुकमार्क में रखें।
scenes.image_brief: A browser bookmarks dropdown open with named folders listed inside it, the tab strip above holding only a few coloured groups, even indoor light.

scenes.narration: Group one task now. Name it. Collapse it. Watch the bar clear.
scenes.caption: अभी एक काम का ग्रुप बनाएं। नाम दें। सिमटाएं और बार को साफ़ देखें।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop on a clear desk showing a browser with one freshly collapsed coloured tab group and open space along the tab strip, a lamp lit in the corner.

title: 😳 Lavanya's autofill keeps an old address... the entry she must delete #browser #autofill
title_alts: 📦 Lavanya edits her autofill list... old addresses hide in settings #browser #autofill
😤 Lavanya's parcel ships to her old flat... one autofill row she kept #browser #autofill
description_hook: A browser keeps every address you ever typed, and checkout grabs the top one. Clearing that list takes about a minute.

characters.name: Lavanya
characters.description: thirty-five, hair in a bun, mustard sweater, reading glasses pushed up

scenes.narration: Lavanya's parcel went to the flat she left.
scenes.caption: लावण्या का पार्सल उस फ़्लैट पर गया जो उसने छोड़ दिया था।
scenes.image_brief: A cardboard parcel left on the doorstep of an unfamiliar flat with a taped shipping label facing up, stairwell shadows, flat overcast light.

scenes.narration: Browsers save every address you ever typed into a checkout form.
scenes.caption: ब्राउज़र हर वह पता सेव कर लेता है जो आपने फ़ॉर्म में टाइप किया।
scenes.image_brief: A checkout page open on a laptop with a dropdown of suggested addresses hanging below the address field, a kitchen table behind it, morning light.

scenes.narration: The list never expires on its own. Checkout picks the top row, not the right one.
scenes.caption: यह सूची खुद कभी खत्म नहीं होती। चेकआउट सबसे ऊपर वाला पता उठाता है, सही वाला नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A browser saved addresses list on a monitor showing several similar entries stacked together, the top one clearly older, cool white desk light.

scenes.narration: Have your correct address written out exactly as you want it printed.
scenes.caption: अपना सही पता वैसे ही लिखकर रखें जैसे वह छपना चाहिए।
scenes.image_brief: A handwritten address on a notepad page beside a laptop, each line clearly separate, a pen resting across the pad, soft daylight from a window.

scenes.narration: Nothing to install. Only the browser settings page.
scenes.caption: कुछ इंस्टॉल नहीं करना है। बस ब्राउज़र की सेटिंग्स खोलें।
scenes.image_brief: A browser settings page open on a laptop with a search box at the top and a list of setting categories below, a quiet desk in even light.

scenes.narration: Open settings and find autofill, then open addresses.
scenes.caption: सेटिंग्स खोलें, ऑटोफ़िल ढूंढें, फिर पते वाला हिस्सा खोलें।
scenes.image_brief: A browser settings panel showing an autofill section with an addresses row highlighted and a small arrow at its right edge, bright screen in a dim room.

scenes.narration: Delete every entry you no longer live at or ship to.
scenes.caption: हर वह पता हटा दें जहां आप अब न रहते हैं, न सामान भेजते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A saved addresses list on screen with one entry expanded and a delete option beside it, the other entries dimmed behind the panel, lamp light.

scenes.narration: Add the current one, then save it as the only address.
scenes.caption: अब मौजूदा पता जोड़ें और उसे अकेला पता बनाकर सेव करें।
scenes.image_brief: A single saved address entry filled into a form panel on screen with an empty list behind it and a save button below, warm evening light.

scenes.narration: Open any checkout page and tap the address field once.
scenes.caption: कोई भी चेकआउट पेज खोलें और पते के खाने पर एक बार टैप करें।
scenes.image_brief: A phone lying on a desk with a checkout page open, the address field tapped and a single suggestion appearing under it, daylight from the left.

scenes.narration: Only one suggestion should appear. Is it the right one?
scenes.caption: सिर्फ़ एक सुझाव दिखना चाहिए। क्या वही सही है?
scenes.image_brief: A checkout form on a laptop with one address suggestion shown under the field and nothing else in the dropdown, clean bright screen.

scenes.narration: Leave card details alone if a device is shared. Store those nowhere but your memory.
scenes.caption: साझा डिवाइस पर कार्ड की जानकारी सेव न करें। उसे कहीं भी न रखें।
scenes.image_brief: A shared laptop on a living room table with a payment form open and the card number boxes left empty, a second chair pulled up, low lamp light.

scenes.narration: And never clear autofill while a form is half filled.
scenes.caption: और आधा भरा फ़ॉर्म खुला हो तो ऑटोफ़िल कभी साफ़ न करें।
scenes.image_brief: A half completed order form on screen with several fields still blank and a settings window open behind it, a cluttered desk, dim light.

scenes.narration: Open autofill tonight. Delete the dead addresses. Keep one only.
scenes.caption: आज ऑटोफ़िल खोलें। पुराने पते हटाएं। सिर्फ़ एक रखें।
scenes.image_brief: A browser saved addresses page on a laptop holding exactly one entry with plenty of empty space below it, a single lamp lighting a night desk.

title: 🔔 Pranav's laptop pings all day... the notification he allowed once #browser #notifications
title_alts: 🔇 Pranav mutes one site's notifications... the padlock panel does it #browser #notifications
😵 Pranav allowed notifications once... every tab now interrupts his work #browser #notifications
description_hook: One tap on allow buys a site the right to interrupt you forever. The padlock beside the address bar takes that right back.

characters.name: Pranav
characters.description: forty, greying temples, pale blue shirt, pen clipped to pocket

scenes.narration: A pop-up slides in while Pranav is typing. Again.
scenes.caption: प्रणव टाइप कर रहा है और कोने से एक पॉप-अप आ जाता है। फिर से।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop showing a half typed document with a small notification card sliding in over the bottom corner of the screen, papers spread on a desk, afternoon light.

scenes.narration: One site asked to send you notifications and you tapped allow once.
scenes.caption: एक साइट ने नोटिफ़िकेशन भेजने की अनुमति मांगी और आपने एक बार हां कर दी।
scenes.image_brief: A website with a permission bubble hanging under the address bar asking to show notifications, an allow button and a block button side by side, bright screen.

scenes.narration: That permission is stored per site, forever. It survives every restart and update.
scenes.caption: यह अनुमति हर साइट की अलग सेव रहती है। रीस्टार्ट या अपडेट से भी नहीं जाती।
scenes.image_brief: A browser site permissions page on a monitor listing site names with notification switches turned on beside them, cool even light in a quiet room.

scenes.narration: No tools needed. Note which pop-up keeps arriving through the day.
scenes.caption: कुछ इंस्टॉल नहीं चाहिए। नोट करें कि दिनभर कौन सा पॉप-अप आता रहता है।
scenes.image_brief: A sticky note on the edge of a monitor with one website name written on it, the screen behind it showing a plain article page, morning light.

scenes.narration: Open the site, then click the padlock beside its address.
scenes.caption: वह साइट खोलें, फिर पते के पास बने ताले पर क्लिक करें।
scenes.image_brief: The left end of a browser address bar filling the screen with the small padlock icon lit and the rest of the toolbar soft behind it.

scenes.narration: Find notifications in that small panel and set it to block.
scenes.caption: उस छोटे पैनल में नोटिफ़िकेशन ढूंढें और उसे ब्लॉक पर सेट करें।
scenes.image_brief: A small site information panel open under the address bar with a notifications row and its setting switched to block, dim room lit by the display.

scenes.narration: Now open settings and check the site permissions list for others.
scenes.caption: अब सेटिंग्स खोलें और साइट परमिशन की सूची में बाकी साइटें देखें।
scenes.image_brief: A browser settings page open to site permissions with a long list of sites and their notification states, a scrollbar partway down, white desk light.

scenes.narration: Reload the site. No permission prompt, no pop-up.
scenes.caption: साइट फिर लोड करें। न अनुमति का सवाल, न कोई पॉप-अप।
scenes.image_brief: A freshly reloaded web page on a laptop with a clean address bar and no bubbles or cards over it anywhere, daylight from a window on the right.

scenes.narration: Work for an hour. Did anything slide in from the corner?
scenes.caption: एक घंटा काम करें। कोने से कुछ आया क्या?
scenes.image_brief: A laptop on a desk beside a wall clock whose hands have moved on, the screen holding a single undisturbed document, calm afternoon light.

scenes.narration: Do not block everything blindly. Some banking alerts arrive this way.
scenes.caption: आंख बंद करके सब ब्लॉक न करें। कुछ बैंक अलर्ट इसी रास्ते आते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A phone and a laptop on the same table, a bank alert visible in a browser tab on the laptop, evening lamp light between them.

scenes.narration: And a browser setting cannot silence your phone apps.
scenes.caption: और ब्राउज़र की सेटिंग आपके फ़ोन के एप चुप नहीं करा सकती।
scenes.image_brief: A phone lying face up on a desk with its own app notification on the lock screen, a laptop behind it showing browser settings, low light.

scenes.narration: Open one padlock now. Block the noisiest site. Keep working.
scenes.caption: अभी एक ताला खोलें। सबसे शोर वाली साइट ब्लॉक करें। काम जारी रखें।
scenes.image_brief: A browser window with the padlock panel open and a block setting just applied, the page behind it calm and static, a single lamp on a night desk.

title: 🤨 Trisha's page ignores her edits... the cached copy the browser keeps #browser #cache
title_alts: 🔄 Trisha forces a hard reload... it refetches the page, not the cache #browser #cache
😤 Trisha rewrote a working file twice... the browser cache lied to her #browser #cache
description_hook: The file is saved and the page still shows yesterday. A hard reload makes the browser fetch the page instead of trusting its own copy.

characters.name: Trisha
characters.description: twenty-six, curly shoulder length hair, denim jacket, red wristband

scenes.narration: Trisha saved the file. She reloads. The page looks identical.
scenes.caption: त्रिशा ने फ़ाइल सेव की। फिर रीलोड किया। पेज वैसा ही दिख रहा है।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop on a desk showing a web page with a heading and a paragraph, a code editor window behind it with a saved file tab, evening light from a window.

scenes.narration: Your browser stored a copy of that page to load faster next time.
scenes.caption: ब्राउज़र ने उस पेज की एक कॉपी रख ली थी, ताकि अगली बार जल्दी खुले।
scenes.image_brief: A browser page on screen beside a panel of layered document tiles standing for stored copies of that page, cool blue display glow in a dark room.

scenes.narration: It trusts the old copy until the copy expires. Your edit is sitting there, unseen.
scenes.caption: कॉपी की मियाद खत्म होने तक वह पुरानी कॉपी ही मानता है। आपका बदलाव वहीं छिपा रहता है।
scenes.image_brief: A monitor showing an old version of a web page with an outdated heading while a text editor behind it holds the new line, lamp light on the desk.

scenes.narration: Have the file saved and the page open in one window, side by side.
scenes.caption: फ़ाइल सेव रखें और वही पेज एक ही विंडो में साथ खोलकर रखें।
scenes.image_brief: A wide monitor split between a text editor holding a saved file on the left and the same page loaded in a browser on the right, daylight from behind.

scenes.narration: Know the exact line you changed, so you can look for it.
scenes.caption: याद रखें कि आपने कौन सी लाइन बदली थी, ताकि उसे ढूंढ सकें।
scenes.image_brief: A text editor open on screen with one line of text clearly highlighted inside a block of code, the rest of the lines dimmed, warm desk lamp light.

scenes.narration: Hold Shift and click the reload button beside the address bar.
scenes.caption: शिफ़्ट दबाए रखें और पते के पास रीलोड बटन पर क्लिक करें।
scenes.image_brief: A browser toolbar filling the screen with the circular reload button lit up beside the address bar, the page below pale and static.

scenes.narration: If the old page stays, open the developer tools first.
scenes.caption: अगर पुराना पेज ही रहे, तो पहले डेवलपर टूल्स खोलें।
scenes.image_brief: A browser window with developer tools docked along the right side showing a network list, the page squeezed into the left half, dim room.

scenes.narration: Then long press reload and choose empty cache and hard reload.
scenes.caption: फिर रीलोड को देर तक दबाएं और एम्प्टी कैश एंड हार्ड रीलोड चुनें।
scenes.image_brief: A long press menu open beneath a browser reload button with three reload options listed and the last one highlighted, the screen the only light.

scenes.narration: Search the page for your changed line. Is it there now?
scenes.caption: पेज में अपनी बदली हुई लाइन खोजें। अब दिख रही है?
scenes.image_brief: A web page on a laptop with the find bar open at the top right and one phrase highlighted in the body text, morning light on the keyboard.

scenes.narration: Open the same page in a private window as a second opinion.
scenes.caption: वही पेज एक प्राइवेट विंडो में खोलकर दूसरी राय ले लें।
scenes.image_brief: Two browser windows on one monitor, one ordinary and one private with a dark toolbar, both showing the same page, cool even light.

scenes.narration: Stop if a private window is also stale. Then it is the server, not you.
scenes.caption: प्राइवेट विंडो में भी पुराना दिखे तो रुक जाएं। मामला सर्वर का है, आपका नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A private browser window on a laptop showing the same old page with a server status panel open beside it, curtains drawn, low light.

scenes.narration: Try Shift reload once today. Then learn what your browser has been hiding.
scenes.caption: आज एक बार शिफ़्ट रीलोड आज़माएं। देखें ब्राउज़र क्या छिपा रहा था।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop keyboard with the Shift key clearly lit and a browser page above it caught mid refresh, a mug of tea beside the trackpad, morning light.
